chapterTitle: Chapter 1: The Winged Whales resting ground (Ceres)
editorText:
The Earth federation had set up an efficient system that supported human life, however the scarcity of resources and the reach to attain further and newer minerals, had extended the outer reach of the federation's presence in the Solar system, or what they often referred to as SOL-1. It did not make sense to attribute resources to terraforming, instead deep space travel was deeply invested in, targeting skip space which piggy backed off stationed gravity recharge points outside of each main planet within SOL-1. The current concluded best path forward from AI driven time prediction’s and Engine technology scaling and revolutionary research were detecting new channels of energy within SOL-1. The Federation's mission was now to colonize a planet with breathable air, in a neighboring solar system.

It was more resourceful , to inhabit the possibility of making it to a planet which no longer required Terra-forming. John entered the classroom, where he was met by 19 other students. John was 20. And on this occasion last to arrive having been called to the bridge for a brief with Commander Marcellus. “Sorry for my late attendance” Said John, “Business with Commander Athos”. John then proceeded to his seat at the end of the table, his name chauffeured across a tag. The tables in the room formed a horse-shoe, allowing for the instructor to easily and leisurely stroll in front of his students with technical equipment. John found himself at the back of the classroom. “I like this.. Quiet” John thought to himself. The horseshoe shaped room allowed the teacher to really engage with his students. All of the students could see one another, encouraging communication and triangulation. Todays class covered human physiology. The different partial pressures and the coinciding effects of these various gases as they traversed their bodies. How their bodies would deal with cryo sleep, and how intermittent “wake ups” would help to re-activate their muscles. One might walk into the classroom and envision it as a surgeon's operating theater, although the center lacked the operation table. Several utensils were scattered, one might even mistake the classroom for a torture room. A student begged the question “why do we need medical utensils in a deep space travel class” “Oh well you don’t, but those of you that have elected to be the deep space medic, which is a requirement under the code to have 1 for every 7 man on the vessel, they will be their in the event a doctor can’t help you. If you are going into deep space you would not want to know that none of your pals could help you out if something goes wrong. In the event that this occurs, due to the scarce resources and limited personnel on board, you may need to depend on your buddy to save your life should something go wrong. In the event that something does, the trained Deep Space Medic Technician will come linked with the best doctors from the earth federation. And will be guided through any rigorous operation he is required to take. They will be there to help you.” Shai was intrigued by this, she liked the through of being able to know and do it all. To be able to help her fellow travellers in the event of a crisis. “So what kind of remuneration does a deep space medic technician get,” Asked Shai. “Well I am glad you asked Shai, let me just say that the remuneration is not what’s important here. it is the honour and privilege that you might save a life. If you think about the money then you won’t be present in your education, If it is something that intrigues you, but I add that, it is the honour and the privilege in such extenuating circumstances that you may save a life. if you go in thinking about the money you won’t go in thinking about the life at hand. Therefore we recruit to the deep space medic technician courses on a strict personality assessment. It’s an application process, in which you must express the reasons why you want to become a deep space medic technician. Get through that process first, then we can talk about the remuneration , “Good answer” Responded Shai. “I like your answer”.
